g.text: AI circular financing · selected disclosed loops
Research cutoff: 5 October 2026 · USD · funding, purchases and guarantees have different timing
Purple: funding · blue: commercial purchases · amber: contingent support · pink: warrants · dashed: commitment / conditional

svg.title: Amazon × OpenAI · circular financing
svg.desc: As of 5 October 2026. Amazon / AWS to OpenAI: $50B equity investment paid; Q1–after June 2026 · disclosed 30 Jul. OpenAI to Amazon / AWS: $100B incremental AWS contract · 8 years; 27 Feb 2026 · future consumption
svg.text: Research cutoff: 5 Oct 2026 · arrows show financing / commercial direction

svg.title: Amazon × Anthropic · circular financing
svg.desc: As of 5 October 2026. Amazon / AWS to Anthropic: $18B cumulative investment paid; Paid through 30 Jun 2026. Anthropic to Amazon / AWS: >$100B incremental AWS contract · 10 years; 20 Apr 2026 · delivery milestones apply. Amazon / AWS to Anthropic: $15B remaining contingent facility; As of 30 Jun 2026
svg.text: Also: $15B remaining contingent facility · As of 30 Jun 2026
Research cutoff: 5 Oct 2026 · arrows show financing / commercial direction
